source_refs.note: Exercise 4.2, Question 1: Evaluate six determinants, parts (i)-(vi) (book page 58).

blocks.explanation:
Yeh ek simple number wala \(3 \times 3\) determinant hai, aur humein sirf iski value (ek number) nikalni hai.
Is mein koi zero ya common factor nahi jo kaam aasaan kare, is liye seedha row 1 ke along expansion karenge.
Plan: row 1 ke teen minors nikalein, un par signs \(+,\,-,\,+\) lagayein, phir jama kar dein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 1 & -2 & -4 \\ 3 & -1 & -3 \\ -2 & 3 & 2 \end{vmatrix}\)
Humein find karna hai: \(\Delta\) ki value.
Tareeqa: Row 1 ke along expansion: \(\Delta = a_{11}A_{11} + a_{12}A_{12} + a_{13}A_{13}\). Yahan \(A_{ij} = (-1)^{i+j}M_{ij}\) cofactor (sign wala minor) hai. Row 1 ke liye signs ka pattern \(+,\,-,\,+\) hota hai. Yeh pattern yaad rakhna aasaan hai: checkerboard (shatranj ki bisaat) ki tarah plus aur minus baari baari aate hain, aur top-left hamesha plus hota hai.

Minor \(M_{11}\) (row 1 aur column 1 chhupa dein)
\[M_{11} = \begin{vmatrix} -1 & -3 \\ 3 & 2 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= (-1)(2) - (-3)(3)\]
\[= -2 + 9 = 7\]
Kyun: Minor ka matlab hai: us entry ki row aur column ko ungli se chhupa dein, jo \(2 \times 2\) bacha us ki value. \(2 \times 2\) ka rule: leading diagonal ka product minus doosre diagonal ka product.
Dhyan dein: \(-(-3)(3)\) mein do minus hain, is liye yeh \(+9\) banta hai.

Minor \(M_{12}\) (row 1 aur column 2 chhupa dein)
\[M_{12} = \begin{vmatrix} 3 & -3 \\ -2 & 2 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= (3)(2) - (-3)(-2)\]
\[= 6 - 6 = 0\]
Kyun: \((-3)(-2) = +6\) hai, aur 6 mein se 6 minus karne se zero aata hai. Zero minor hona bilkul theek hai; is ka matlab hai yeh term jawab mein kuch add nahi karegi.

Minor \(M_{13}\) (row 1 aur column 3 chhupa dein)
\[M_{13} = \begin{vmatrix} 3 & -1 \\ -2 & 3 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= (3)(3) - (-1)(-2)\]
\[= 9 - 2 = 7\]
Kyun: Wohi \(2 \times 2\) wala rule. \((-1)(-2) = +2\), aur hum use minus karte hain, is liye \(9 - 2\).

Signs laga kar jama karein
\[\Delta = 1(7) - (-2)(0) + (-4)(7)\]
\[= 7 + 0 - 28\]
\[= -21\]
Kyun: Row 1 ki har entry ko us ke cofactor se multiply karte hain. Cofactors hain \(+M_{11},\ -M_{12},\ +M_{13}\). Entry ka apna sign (jaise \(-4\)) alag cheez hai aur position ka sign alag; dono ko saath rakhna hai.
Dhyan dein: Bahut se students entry ka minus aur position ka minus ek hi samajh lete hain. Dono ko alag alag brackets mein likhein to ghalti nahi hogi.

Tasdeeq (column 1 ke along expand kar ke)
\[\Delta = 1(7) - 3\begin{vmatrix} -2 & -4 \\ 3 & 2 \end{vmatrix} + (-2)\begin{vmatrix} -2 & -4 \\ -1 & -3 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= 7 - 3(8) - 2(2)\]
\[= 7 - 24 - 4 = -21 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Determinant ki value kisi bhi row ya column ke along nikalein, ek hi aati hai. Is liye doosre raste se dobara nikal kar dekhna behtareen check hai. Yahan \((-2)(2) - (-4)(3) = 8\) aur \((-2)(-3) - (-4)(-1) = 2\).

blocks.explanation:
Phir ek number wala \(3 \times 3\) determinant hai; is ki value nikalni hai.
Kisi row ya column mein zero nahi, is liye row 1 ke along expansion hi sab se seedha rasta hai.
Plan: \(M_{11}, M_{12}, M_{13}\) nikalein, signs \(+,\,-,\,+\) lagayein, aur jama karein. Har product bracket mein likhenge kyunke negative numbers kaafi hain.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 5 & 2 & -3 \\ 3 & 10 & -1 \\ -2 & 1 & -2 \end{vmatrix}\)
Humein find karna hai: \(\Delta\) ki value.
Tareeqa: Row 1 ke along expansion, signs \(+,\,-,\,+\): \(\Delta = 5M_{11} - 2M_{12} + (-3)M_{13}\). Yeh formula isliye sahi hai ke determinant = kisi bhi row ki entries \(\times\) un ke cofactors ka jama.

Minor \(M_{11}\)
\[M_{11} = \begin{vmatrix} 10 & -1 \\ 1 & -2 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= (10)(-2) - (-1)(1)\]
\[= -20 + 1 = -19\]
Kyun: Row 1 aur column 1 chhupane se yeh \(2 \times 2\) bachta hai. \(-(-1)(1) = +1\), is liye \(-20 + 1\).

Minor \(M_{12}\)
\[M_{12} = \begin{vmatrix} 3 & -1 \\ -2 & -2 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= (3)(-2) - (-1)(-2)\]
\[= -6 - 2 = -8\]
Kyun: Row 1 aur column 2 chhupaya. \((-1)(-2) = +2\) hai, aur usay minus karna hai, is liye \(-6 - 2 = -8\).
Dhyan dein: Yahan aksar students \(-6 + 2\) likh dete hain. Pehle product poora nikalein, phir minus lagayein.

Minor \(M_{13}\)
\[M_{13} = \begin{vmatrix} 3 & 10 \\ -2 & 1 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= (3)(1) - (10)(-2)\]
\[= 3 + 20 = 23\]
Kyun: Row 1 aur column 3 chhupaya. Minus ke saath negative number ho to plus ban jata hai.

Signs laga kar jama karein
\[\Delta = 5(-19) - 2(-8) + (-3)(23)\]
\[= -95 + 16 - 69\]
\[= -148\]
Kyun: Har entry ko us ke cofactor se multiply kiya: \(5 \times (+M_{11})\), \(2 \times (-M_{12})\), \((-3) \times (+M_{13})\). Phir teeno ko jama kiya: \(-95 + 16 = -79\), aur \(-79 - 69 = -148\).

Tasdeeq (column 2 ke along)
\[\Delta = -2(-8) + 10\begin{vmatrix} 5 & -3 \\ -2 & -2 \end{vmatrix} - 1\begin{vmatrix} 5 & -3 \\ 3 & -1 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= 16 + 10(-16) - 1(4)\]
\[= 16 - 160 - 4 = -148 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Column 2 ke signs \(-,\,+,\,-\) hain (checkerboard pattern). \((5)(-2) - (-3)(-2) = -10 - 6 = -16\) aur \((5)(-1) - (-3)(3) = -5 + 9 = 4\). Doosre raste se bhi wohi jawab aaya, to hum mutmain hain.

blocks.explanation:
Number wala \(3 \times 3\) determinant hai; value chahiye.
Row 1 ke numbers \(1, 2, -3\) chhote hain, is liye usi ke along expand karna aasaan rahega.
Plan: teen minors, signs \(+,\,-,\,+\), jama.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 1 & 2 & -3 \\ -1 & 3 & 5 \\ -2 & 5 & 6 \end{vmatrix}\)
Humein find karna hai: \(\Delta\) ki value.
Tareeqa: Row 1 ke along expansion: \(\Delta = 1\cdot M_{11} - 2M_{12} + (-3)M_{13}\). Chhote numbers wali row chunne se multiplication mein ghalti ka chance kam ho jata hai.

Minor \(M_{11}\)
\[M_{11} = \begin{vmatrix} 3 & 5 \\ 5 & 6 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= 18 - 25 = -7\]
Kyun: Row 1, column 1 chhupaya; \(3 \times 6 = 18\) aur \(5 \times 5 = 25\). Chhote mein se bara minus ho to jawab negative hota hai.

Minor \(M_{13}\)
\[M_{13} = \begin{vmatrix} -1 & 3 \\ -2 & 5 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= (-1)(5) - (3)(-2)\]
\[= -5 + 6 = 1\]
Kyun: Row 1, column 3 chhupaya; wohi \(2 \times 2\) rule.

Signs laga kar jama karein
\[\Delta = 1(-7) - 2(4) + (-3)(1)\]
\[= -7 - 8 - 3\]
\[= -18\]
Kyun: Row 1 ki entries ko cofactors \(+M_{11},\ -M_{12},\ +M_{13}\) se multiply kar ke jama kiya. Teeno terms negative aayin, is liye seedha jama: \(-18\).

Tasdeeq (row operations se)
\[R_2 + R_1 \to R_2,\quad R_3 + 2R_1 \to R_3\]
\[\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 1 & 2 & -3 \\ 0 & 5 & 2 \\ 0 & 9 & 0 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= 1(0 - 18) = -18 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Property vii kehti hai ke ek row ka multiple doosri row mein add karne se determinant ki value nahi badalti. Is se column 1 mein do zero ban gaye, aur sirf \(1 \times (5 \cdot 0 - 2 \cdot 9)\) bacha. Yeh tareeqa bara numbers walay determinants mein bohat waqt bachata hai, isay bhi seekh lijiye.

blocks.prompt: 1 (iv) Evaluate the following determinant: \(\begin{vmatrix} a+b & a-b & a \\ a & a+b & a-b \\ a-b & a & a+b \end{vmatrix}\)
blocks.explanation:
Is determinant mein letters \(a\) aur \(b\) hain; humein iski value ko ek chhoti si expression mein laana hai.
Ghaur karein: har row ka total \(3a\) hai (kyunke \(+b\) aur \(-b\) cancel ho jate hain). Yeh ishara hai ke columns jama karne se common factor milega.
Plan: \(C_1 + C_2 + C_3 \to C_1\), \(3a\) bahar, zeros banayein, phir expand karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} a+b & a-b & a \\ a & a+b & a-b \\ a-b & a & a+b \end{vmatrix}\)
Humein find karna hai: \(\Delta\) ki value.
Tareeqa: Properties of determinants. Seedha expand karein to \((a+b)(a+b)\) jaise lambe brackets aate hain aur ghalti ka chance barh jata hai. Is liye: columns ko kisi column mein jama karne se value nahi badalti (Property vii), aur kisi column ka common factor bahar aa sakta hai (Property v).

Teeno columns ko column 1 mein jama karein
\[C_1 + C_2 + C_3 \to C_1\]
\[\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 3a & a-b & a \\ 3a & a+b & a-b \\ 3a & a & a+b \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Row 1: \((a+b) + (a-b) + a = 3a\). Row 2 aur row 3 mein bhi wohi teen cheezein hain, sirf tarteeb alag hai, is liye un ka total bhi \(3a\) hai. Ab column 1 ki har entry \(3a\) hai, jo common factor ban sakta hai.

Column 1 se \(3a\) bahar nikalein
\[\Delta = 3a\begin{vmatrix} 1 & a-b & a \\ 1 & a+b & a-b \\ 1 & a & a+b \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Property v: agar ek column ki har entry mein ek hi factor ho to woh poore determinant ke bahar aa jata hai. Column 1 mein ab sirf 1 bache, jo zeros banane mein bohat madad karte hain.

Column 1 mein zeros banayein
\[R_2 - R_1 \to R_2,\quad R_3 - R_1 \to R_3\]
\[\Delta = 3a\begin{vmatrix} 1 & a-b & a \\ 0 & 2b & -b \\ 0 & b & b \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Nayi \(R_2\): \((a+b) - (a-b) = 2b\) aur \((a-b) - a = -b\). Nayi \(R_3\): \(a - (a-b) = b\) aur \((a+b) - a = b\). Ek row ko doosri mein se minus karna Property vii ka hi case hai, is liye value wohi rehti hai.
Dhyan dein: \(a - (a - b)\) mein bracket kholte waqt sign badalta hai: \(a - a + b = b\).

Column 1 ke along expand karein
\[\Delta = 3a \cdot 1 \cdot \begin{vmatrix} 2b & -b \\ b & b \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= 3a\,[2b^2 - (-b^2)]\]
\[= 3a \cdot 3b^2 = 9ab^2\]
Kyun: Column 1 mein sirf top wala 1 non-zero hai; baaqi zero ke saath multiply ho kar khatam. Position \((1,1)\) ka sign \(+\) hai. \(2 \times 2\) mein \((2b)(b) - (-b)(b) = 2b^2 + b^2 = 3b^2\).

Tasdeeq (numbers rakh kar)
\[a = 2,\ b = 3:\ \begin{vmatrix} 5 & -1 & 2 \\ 2 & 5 & -1 \\ -1 & 2 & 5 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= 5(27) + 1(9) + 2(9) = 162\]
\[9ab^2 = 9(2)(9) = 162 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Letters wale jawab ko check karne ka sab se aasaan tareeqa: chhote numbers rakh kar asal determinant aur apna jawab dono nikal lein. Row 1 expansion: \(5(25 + 2) - (-1)(10 - 1) + 2(4 + 5)\). Dono 162 aaye, to jawab sahi hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key mein part (iv) ka jawab \(9a^2b - b^3\) likha hai, jo ghalat hai. Check kijiye: \(a = 2,\ b = 3\) rakhein to \(9a^2b - b^3 = 108 - 27 = 81\) aata hai, jab ke determinant ki asal value 162 hai. Sahi jawab \(9ab^2\) hai.

blocks.explanation:
Number wala \(3 \times 3\) determinant; value nikalni hai.
Is mein bohat se negative numbers hain, is liye har product bracket mein likhenge taake sign ki ghalti na ho.
Plan: row 1 ke along expansion, signs \(+,\,-,\,+\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 1 & 20 & -2 \\ -1 & -1 & -3 \\ 2 & 4 & -1 \end{vmatrix}\)
Humein find karna hai: \(\Delta\) ki value.
Tareeqa: Row 1 ke along expansion: \(\Delta = 1\cdot M_{11} - 20M_{12} + (-2)M_{13}\). Row 1 mein 20 bara number hai, lekin baaqi rows mein zyada negative signs hain, is liye row 1 hi theek hai.

Minor \(M_{12}\)
\[M_{12} = \begin{vmatrix} -1 & -3 \\ 2 & -1 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= (-1)(-1) - (-3)(2)\]
\[= 1 + 6 = 7\]
Kyun: Row 1, column 2 chhupaya; wohi \(2 \times 2\) rule.

Minor \(M_{13}\)
\[M_{13} = \begin{vmatrix} -1 & -1 \\ 2 & 4 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= (-1)(4) - (-1)(2)\]
\[= -4 + 2 = -2\]
Kyun: Row 1, column 3 chhupaya.

Signs laga kar jama karein
\[\Delta = 1(13) - 20(7) + (-2)(-2)\]
\[= 13 - 140 + 4\]
\[= -123\]
Kyun: Row 1 ki entries \(\times\) cofactors \(+M_{11},\ -M_{12},\ +M_{13}\). Aakhri term mein entry \(-2\) aur minor \(-2\) dono negative hain, is liye product \(+4\).

Tasdeeq (row operations se)
\[R_2 + R_1 \to R_2,\quad R_3 - 2R_1 \to R_3\]
\[\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 1 & 20 & -2 \\ 0 & 19 & -5 \\ 0 & -36 & 3 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= 1[(19)(3) - (-5)(-36)]\]
\[= 57 - 180 = -123 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Row ka multiple doosri row mein add karne se value nahi badalti (Property vii). Nayi \(R_2\): \((-1+1,\ -1+20,\ -3-2)\); nayi \(R_3\): \((2-2,\ 4-40,\ -1+4)\). Column 1 mein do zero ban gaye, aur wohi jawab aaya.

blocks.prompt: 1 (vi) Evaluate the following determinant: \(\begin{vmatrix} 2x & x & x \\ y & 2y & y \\ z & z & 2z \end{vmatrix}\)
blocks.explanation:
Letters wala determinant hai. Ghaur se dekhein: row 1 ki har entry mein \(x\) hai, row 2 mein \(y\), aur row 3 mein \(z\).
Is liye pehle yeh factors bahar nikalenge, phir sirf numbers ka determinant bachega.
Plan: \(x, y, z\) rows se bahar, phir chhota determinant expand.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 2x & x & x \\ y & 2y & y \\ z & z & 2z \end{vmatrix}\)
Humein find karna hai: \(\Delta\) ki value.
Tareeqa: Property v: kisi row ka common factor determinant ke bahar aa sakta hai. Yeh kaam pehle karne se letters khatam ho jate hain aur hisaab bohat aasaan ho jata hai.

Rows se factors bahar nikalein
\[\Delta = xyz\begin{vmatrix} 2 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 2 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(R_1\) se \(x\), \(R_2\) se \(y\), \(R_3\) se \(z\) bahar aaye. Har row se factor sirf ek dafa nikalta hai, chahe us row mein teen entries hon.
Dhyan dein: Kuch students sochte hain ke teen entries hain to \(x^3\) bahar aayega. Aisa nahi; poori row ka ek hi factor bahar aata hai.

Row 1 ke along expand karein
\[= xyz\,[2(4 - 1) - 1(2 - 1) + 1(1 - 2)]\]
\[= xyz\,(6 - 1 - 1)\]
\[= 4xyz\]
Kyun: Signs \(+,\,-,\,+\). Minors: \(\begin{vmatrix} 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 \end{vmatrix} = 3\), \(\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 \end{vmatrix} = 1\), \(\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 1 & 1 \end{vmatrix} = -1\). Phir \(2(3) - 1(1) + 1(-1) = 4\).

Tasdeeq (numbers rakh kar)
\[x = y = z = 1:\ \begin{vmatrix} 2 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 2 \end{vmatrix} = 4\]
\[4xyz = 4 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Sab letters ko 1 rakh dein to asal determinant bhi 4 aur hamara jawab bhi 4. Letters wale jawab ko check karne ka yeh aasaan tareeqa hai.
